method.method_draft: Read from the image that the two vertical blue lines are marked parallel, and the two slanted blue lines are also marked parallel. Angle 1 is at the lower-left intersection, and angle 11 is at the upper-right intersection. Use the lower slanted line as a transversal across the two parallel vertical lines to get the corresponding angle at the right vertical line, angle 3, equal to angle 1. Then use the right vertical line as a transversal across the two parallel slanted lines to get angle 11 corresponding to angle 3. Therefore m∠11 = m∠3 = m∠1 = 123.
